question: Does the minimally seeded original M-TARE plus Gazebo system reproduce the exact recorded sensor/pose/waypoint prefix under the same seed while producing a different observed sequence under a different seed?
method: Run the original M-TARE stack serially in the tunnel world for seed 11 twice and seed 23 once, each for exactly 60 simulation seconds. Retain all configured ROS messages and compare exactly 100 scan-synchronous frame fingerprints and 20 waypoints per trial.
baseline: The first seed-11 trial is the identity baseline for the second seed-11 trial. Seed 23 is the required variation control. There is no numerical tolerance or fallback; a mismatch is a sealed system reproducibility failure.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable tunnel-only original-M-TARE qualification with three serial 60-second trials (11, 11, 23); zero model inference, training, method comparison, C09 or C10.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: The exact data, method, 180-second simulation cost and PASS/FAIL evidence were stated immediately before the user replied '批准'; the preceding user message also granted '全部都批准'.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly three trials run once in order: tunnel seed11_a, seed11_b and seed23, each for 60 simulation seconds.
Every required frozen recording topic exists, has the exact ROS type and has at least one message in every trial.
Each trial provides at least 100 scan-synchronous scan/pose frames and 20 finite waypoints; exactly those prefixes are audited.
The complete 100-frame identity rows and 20 waypoint values of seed11_a and seed11_b are exactly equal.
The seed23 100-frame observed sensor/trajectory sequence hash differs from seed11.
Dataset/model/checkpoint reads, model inference, training steps, optimizer steps, C09 reads and C10 reads remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any source, tool, launch file, topic contract or Docker image identity drift.
Any container/ROS/Gazebo/planner/recorder early exit, timeout or incomplete bag.
Any required topic contract failure, insufficient audited records or non-finite pose/waypoint.
Any same-seed mismatch or failure of the different-seed control. No retry, threshold change or metric substitution is permitted.
expected_evidence: Three compressed rosbag files with complete retained messages and per-trial summary JSON.
Exactly 300 scan/pose identity rows and 60 waypoint values plus the comparison JSON.
Per-process raw logs, frozen Data Card/spec, environment/image/tool identities, metrics summary, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 evidence seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU plus Gazebo, 180 total simulation seconds in three serial trials; no GPU, training or learned-model inference.
